plan.rationale: Frozen objective: minimize ttft_ms for the interactive workload (batch=1, prompt_tokens=256, single RTX 4090, BF16 SDPA Qwen3-4B); clean reference ttft_ms=25.11. The only listed revision is f5a797fab6e3796855819951a220124f9d6305b3152f9de9304b60b3a17d4030 (bundles trial-fc57bca7b9-param-f71a7c8a and trial-recovered-19ccfe875f-param-44a0e934), and the framework will run collectors on exactly this candidate. Observed uncertainty from evaluation.json: the screening decision is 'no_valid_parameter_candidate' with quality_and_coverage_valid=false, and all route evidence is candidate-declared telemetry - 728 fused-rms-norm/fused-rms-norm-gated invocations and 2 'parent-fallback:setup-failure:flash-dispatch-refused' routes on call 2441f10600ba127de5cb753c - with the explicit interpretation that such labels must be corroborated by traces or actual exception evidence. (1) candidate_diagnostics: capture the handled exception and propagated library traceback locations behind the flash-dispatch refusal plus executed calls and scalar returns, establishing whether a real library-side setup refusal occurred; no assumption is made that the 2 fallback sites are a performance regression or that reference invocations (68/145 per bundle) are necessarily fallback - they may implement fallback, verification or composition. (2) nsys (available, runs separately): resolve the attribution questions the declared routes raise - confirm fused RMS-norm kernel entries actually executed during the measured prefill window, locate the two refused-dispatch sites' kernel context, and attribute prefill kernel time against the 25.1 ms TTFT budget; torch already ran (coverage.json shows all 66441 kernels associated), so nsys is selected only for route corroboration and prefill attribution, not re-profiling. (3) binding_cost: a candidate exists and is additive (parent 20b69c25... retained, both bundles added; bundle trial-fc57bca7b9 delegates to the parent on 62 of 64 invocations), and the binding summary (requested legacy, effective direct, reason 'no functional replacements', functional_sites null) is exactly the eligible direct-binding case where zero functional replacements does not imply zero binding overhead for ttft-relevant host dispatch; requesting the clean AB/BA whole-invocation passthrough comparison with full quality checks, which will also run in subsequent candidate resource feedback. Excluded: nccl_tuning, collective_calibration and device_telemetry (single-device, no collectives; device-wide NVML readings cannot yield per-kernel attribution), python_runtime (perturbs execution; redundant with the clean binding_cost AB/BA), execution_timeline (torch trace already associated every CPU submission to its CUDA kernel with no unassociated kernels or ambiguous sequences, and the workload's explicit first-token synchronize already bounds GPU completion, so no CPU-submit attribution gap remains).

Parent observations already show the split indirectly (identical 28351488-byte buckets: rank1 ~14.2-22.7ms vs rank0 ~3.2ms), so rank-1 kernel duration is wait-dominated, but a direct wait/wire number is unobtainable.

plan.rationale: Candidate 03c5e5... (sole revision in revisions.json; additive bundle trial-recovered-0f41339f0a-param-afbf38f4 over parent 30c61d..., direct binding 'no functional replacements', candidate-declared route 'aligned_final_backward_barrier' invoked 2x per rank with 0 framework fallbacks and 0 reference invocations) failed parameter screening solely on the step_ms constraint: 144.138ms vs limit 138.660ms (original reference 132.057ms), while the objective's max-rank communication_kernel_sum_ms is essentially unchanged (rank1: 64.149 -> 64.149; only rank0 improved 74.676 -> 63.433). The decisive uncertainties are: (1) whether the ~12ms step regression is binding overhead or candidate logic; (2) what the candidate actually executes and whether its candidate-reported route label holds; (3) whether the aligned final-backward barrier serialized/added synchronization around the final microbatch allreduce (parent observations show 13 allreduces, 12x28351488B + 1x157541376B, with rank-1 kernels 14.2-22.7ms vs rank-0 ~3.2ms on identical buckets, i.e. wait/skew-dominated, so kernel-duration reduction hinges on overlap and arrival alignment, not wire speed); (4) the actual NCCL algorithm/protocol/channel decisions at the observed sizes/dtypes, since kernel entry names alone (ncclDevKernel_AllReduce_Sum_f32_RING_LL) do not identify the protocol. Selections: binding_cost (applicable: additive candidate retaining an installed-parent-empty bundle set, direct binding eligible, and 'no functional replacements' does not imply zero overhead) isolates whole-invocation binding overhead in clean AB/BA workers with full quality checks. candidate_diagnostics records executed candidate calls, handled exceptions with propagated library traceback locations, and scalar returns to corroborate the declared route with actual exception evidence rather than candidate-reported telemetry. execution_timeline supplies CPU-to-CUDA submit associations, synchronization events, per-device intervals and passive CPU gradient post-accumulate callbacks to locate the regression host/device-side and detect added synchronization from the barrier route; it does not replace any communication hook. nsys (available in request.tools and listed) resolves the overlap/attribution question from the GPU side: NCCL kernel intervals, stream concurrency with compute, and gaps around the final microbatch; bucket identity is already established by observed gradient-storage membership in observations.json, so nsys is used only for overlap/gap attribution, not bucket proof or waiting/wire separation. nccl_tuning captures actual NCCL algorithm/protocol/channel decisions at the observed sizes (28351488B and 157541376B, fp32 SUM, world 2) in a separate warmed worker to judge whether kernel durations are protocol-limited. Excluded: torch (already ran; it is the source of communication_kernel_sum_ms); device_telemetry (device-wide native-window readings, not per-collective bytes, and link counters are already recorded unknown); collective_calibration (reference experiment, not a lower bound; does not address skew/overlap or the step constraint); python_runtime (perturbs execution with non-clean inclusive/self times; host-side attribution is covered cleanly by binding_cost plus execution_timeline for this decision). The plan requests collection on this exact candidate; revision set to its exact ID.
